results.title: Quantitative Finance Careers in the UK: 2026 Guide
results.content: Quant finance roles in the UK include quant analyst, quant developer, and risk quant positions. Most entry-level roles require a strong mathematics or physics background and programming skills. Starting salaries at tier-1 banks range from £60k–£90k in London.

results.title: How to Break Into Quant Finance UK
results.content: The typical path into quant finance starts with a maths or physics degree, followed by either a masters in financial mathematics or direct applications to grad schemes at hedge funds and banks.

results.title: UK Hedge Fund Hiring Trends 2026
results.content: London hedge funds continue to hire aggressively in quantitative roles despite broader market uncertainty. Man Group, Two Sigma, and Citadel remain the largest quant employers in the UK.
